aqj-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：一条跑道与平行滑行道铺在沙漠中，航站楼与机坪在跑道中段。
aqj-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: a runway and parallel taxiway laid across desert, with the terminal and apron at its midpoint.

aqj-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 亚喀巴机场航站楼米白色外墙沿弧线展开，墙上写着机场的阿拉伯文与英文名称。
aqj-chatgpt-01.webp.en: The airport's cream terminal curves along the roadside, its facade lettered with the name in Arabic and English.

aqj-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 旅客提着行李走过机坪，登机梯车停在白色客机旁，远处是干燥的山影。
aqj-chatgpt-02.webp.en: Passengers carry their bags across the apron toward boarding stairs parked beside a white narrow-body jet, with dry hills beyond.

aqj-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 白色管制塔底部呈喇叭状向外张开，塔台顶部是环形玻璃窗，背后是裸露的荒山。
aqj-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A white control tower flares outward at its base and carries a ring of glass at the top, with bare desert mountains rising behind.

aqj-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 旅客拖着行李箱从到达厅门口走出，遮阳篷下是玻璃门与一排等候的人。
aqj-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Travellers wheel their suitcases out of the arrivals entrance, where a fabric canopy shades the glass doors and a cluster of waiting people.

aqj-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 从高处看，出发厅前的道路中间隔着修剪整齐的绿篱，斑马线横过路面。
aqj-chatgpt-05.webp.en: From above, a clipped hedge runs down the middle of the road in front of the departures hall, with a zebra crossing laid across it.

aqj-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 机坪上依次停着一排小型公务机，白色机身反射着午后的光，远处是荒山。
aqj-chatgpt-06.webp.en: A row of small business jets stands parked across the apron, their white fuselages catching the afternoon light against bare hills.

aqj-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 水柱从两侧喷向客机，在机身上方架起一道水门，地勤人员站在一旁观看。
aqj-chatgpt-07.webp.en: Water jets spray in from both sides to arch over the airliner, while ground crew in hi-vis vests stand back and watch.
